info.title: Campaign Engine API
info.description: Channel-agnostic retail campaign engine. Send the API key in the `X-Api-Key` header. Polymorphic rules use a `type` discriminator; see docs/rule-reference.md.

get.summary: All live campaigns and the product lists they use
get.description: For local/offline evaluation. Poll with If-None-Match: <etag>; the response is 304 while nothing changed. Contains active and paused campaigns that have not ended; paused ones never apply.

Filter by `entityType` (campaign, productList, store, apiKey, webhook, member, organization) and `entityId` (campaign / list / key / webhook id, store code, user id), `action` (e.g. campaign.activated) or `actorId`.

Filters by status, channel (campaigns without channels match every channel), tag, a free-text search on code and name, and `activeFrom` / `activeTo`: campaigns whose schedule window overlaps that range. `sort` = updated (default), priority, name, code, startsAt, endsAt; `order` = desc (default) or asc.

get.summary: The campaign in plain English, section by section

post.summary: Describe an unsaved definition in plain English

get.summary: Get a campaign by id or code

put.description: Send the `version` you loaded; a different stored version returns 409. Live campaigns are re-checked for conflicts.

post.summary: Activate a draft or paused campaign
post.description: Returns the conflicts with other live campaigns. Error-level conflicts (e.g. duplicate coupon codes) block activation unless force=true.

post.summary: Validate a definition without saving it
Conflicts of a (possibly unsaved) campaign with live campaigns

post.description: Use kind `globalExclusion` for products no campaign may ever discount (tobacco, gold, gift cards, …).

get.summary: Get a product list with its SKUs

delete.summary: Delete a product list that no campaign uses

put.summary: Import SKUs from a CSV or text file
put.description: One SKU per line; for CSV the first column is used and a header row named `sku` is skipped. mode=replace (default) or append. Example: `curl -X PUT --data-binary @skus.csv -H "Content-Type: text/csv" …`

post.description: Stateless: call it on every basket change. With explain=true the response lists every campaign that did not apply and why. Nothing is recorded; call POST /redemptions when the sale completes.
Re-evaluates the final cart and records the applied campaigns against usage limits and budgets. Idempotent on transactionId: retries return the stored result with 200 and replayed=true.

post.summary: Import a sale priced offline from a snapshot
post.description: The sale already happened, so limits are not enforced; usage and budget are still counted. Idempotent on transactionId.

post.summary: Subscribe a URL to change events
post.description: Events: campaign.created|updated|activated|paused|archived|deleted, productList.created|updated|deleted, or wildcards '*' and 'campaign.*'. The signing secret is returned only in this response.

get.summary: List the organization's API keys (secrets are never returned)

post.description: Scopes: `channel` (evaluate, redeem, snapshot) and/or `admin` (management). The `key` field is only returned in this response — store it in the integration's secret store.

post.summary: Create an account (and, with organizationName, an organization owned by it)
post.description: Returns a session token for `Authorization: Bearer`. The web app keeps it in an httpOnly cookie.

get.summary: The signed-in user, the current organization and all memberships

Create another organization (you become its owner) and switch to it

put.summary: Update a store (the code cannot change)

delete.description: Campaigns that list the code keep it; consider deactivating instead.

put.description: Header row required. Columns: sku, name (required), brand, categories (separated by |), active; any other column becomes an attribute. `,` `;` and tab delimiters are detected. Existing SKUs are updated.

get.description: `from` is inclusive and `to` exclusive (ISO 8601). `campaign` filters by campaign code; `search` matches the transaction id.

Redemptions, discount and limit / budget consumption per campaign
What one customer has redeemed, per campaign
Campaign counts and redemption KPIs, with the previous period of the same length
get.description: `from` (inclusive) and `to` (exclusive) are ISO 8601; the default is the last 30 days, the maximum 366 days. Reversed transactions are excluded.

get.summary: Performance of every redeemed or active campaign, best first
get.description: `from` (inclusive) and `to` (exclusive) are ISO 8601; the default is the last 30 days, the maximum 366 days. Reversed transactions are excluded.

get.summary: The campaigns that gave the most discount
get.description: `from` (inclusive) and `to` (exclusive) are ISO 8601; the default is the last 30 days, the maximum 366 days. Reversed transactions are excluded.

get.summary: Daily transactions, redemptions and discount (empty days included)
get.description: `from` (inclusive) and `to` (exclusive) are ISO 8601; the default is the last 30 days, the maximum 366 days. Reversed transactions are excluded. Days are cut in `timeZone` (IANA or Windows id, default UTC), e.g. `Europe/Istanbul`.

metadata.description: Copied from the campaign so channels can map it to their own ids.

code.description: Unique, human-friendly code. Printed on receipts and used by other systems.

priority.description: Higher values are applied first and win ties.

exclusivityGroup.description: At most one campaign per group applies to a cart: the one giving the largest discount.

currency.description: If set, the campaign only applies to carts in this currency.

channels.description: Channels the campaign runs on. Empty means every channel.

customerSegments.description: Customer segments the campaign is for. Empty means everyone, including anonymous customers.

oneOf.description: When set, one of the coupon codes must be present in the cart.

target.description: Products the reward applies to (and that count toward conditions by default).

conditions.description: All conditions must hold. Use `anyOf` / `not` for other logic.

ignoreGlobalExclusions.description: Allows discounting products in global exclusion lists. Use with care.

displayMessage.description: Text shown to the customer / cashier when the campaign applies.

metadata.description: Free-form references to other systems, e.g. `{"erpCampaignNo": "2026-0042"}`.

version.description: Incremented on every change; used for optimistic concurrency.

Campaign.description:
A campaign definition: who gets (audience), what (target + reward), when (schedule),
under which circumstances (conditions) and how often (limits).

CampaignDescription.description: A campaign definition in plain English, section by section.

maxRedemptions.description: Total number of transactions the campaign may be redeemed in.

maxRedemptionsPerCustomer.description: Per identified customer. Anonymous carts are not limited by this.

budget.description: Total discount the campaign may give away over its lifetime.

maxDiscountPerOrder.description: Cap on the discount given to a single cart.

id.description: Optional id of the basket in the calling system; echoed back for tracing.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code. Campaigns restricted to another currency are ignored.

channel.description: Sales channel, free text agreed between systems, e.g. `store`, `web`, `mobile`.

storeId.description: Store / warehouse / web-site code, if the channel has one.

timestamp.description: Moment of sale. Defaults to "now"; offline POS replays send the original time.

shippingAmount.description: Shipping fee before discounts. Only free-shipping rewards touch it.

Cart.description:
The basket a channel (POS, web, mobile, …) asks the engine to price.
All amounts are in string Cart.Currency and include tax the same way the channel's prices do.

lineId.description: Id of the line in the calling system; unique within the cart.

quantity.description: Units or a weight (e.g. 0.750 kg). Unit-based offers only use whole units.

unitPrice.description: Price of one unit before campaign discounts.

categories.description:
Category codes the product belongs to. Send the whole path
(e.g. `["apparel", "apparel-men", "apparel-men-tshirt"]`) so campaigns can target any level.

minimumUnitPrice.description: Price floor: no campaign may bring one unit below this price.

discountable.description: Set to false for items that must never be discounted (e.g. gift cards, deposits).

Condition.description:
A predicate over the cart that must hold for a campaign to apply.
Serialized with a `"type"` discriminator. Conditions always look at the cart as sent by the
channel (list prices), never at discounts given by other campaigns.

ConditionAnyOfCondition.description: At least one nested condition must hold.

ConditionCartAttributeCondition.description: A free-form cart attribute must be present (and, if values are given, equal one of them).

ConditionFirstOrderCondition.description: Only for the customer's first order (as reported by the channel).

oneOf.description: Which lines count. Defaults to the campaign's qualifying lines.
Which lines count. Defaults to the campaign's qualifying lines.

ConditionMinSubtotalCondition.description: "Spend at least X" — e.g. 500 TRY and above.

ConditionNotCondition.description: The nested condition must not hold.

cardBins.description: BIN prefixes; a card matches when its BIN starts with one of them.

ConditionPaymentCondition.description:
Payment-based campaigns: payment method, issuing bank, card BIN prefixes, installment count.
Every non-empty criterion must match.

maxUsesPerCode.description: How many times each code may be redeemed in total (e.g. 1 for single-use codes).

segments.description: Segments / tiers the customer belongs to, e.g. `gold`, `employee`.

subtotal.description: Sum of line gross amounts (quantity × unit price).

total.description: Amount to pay: subtotal − discounts + shipping.

hints.description: Campaigns the customer is close to (e.g. "add 50 more for free shipping").

unusedCouponCodes.description: Coupon codes in the cart that did not produce a discount.

rejections.description: Only filled when an explanation was requested.

EvaluationResult.description: The priced cart: what applied, how much, to which lines — and optionally why not.

bankCode.description: Issuing bank code, for bank-sponsored campaigns.

cardBin.description: First 6–8 digits of the card number.

code.description: Stable code campaigns refer to, e.g. `NO-DISCOUNT`, `SUMMER-26-TSHIRTS`.

ProductList.description: A named, reusable set of SKUs maintained through the API instead of SQL scripts.

ProductSelector.description: Describes a set of products. A line matches when it matches any include criterion (or there are no include criteria at all) and no exclude criterion. All comparisons are case-insensitive.

Reward.description: What the customer gets when a campaign applies. Serialized with a `"type"` discriminator.

RewardAmountDiscountReward.description: "100 off the basket" or, with bool AmountDiscountReward.PerUnit, "10 off every unit".

RewardBundlePriceReward.description: "Any 3 for 100". Sets are built from the most expensive units first.

discountPercent.description: Discount on the "get" units; 100 means free.

oneOf.description: Where the "get" units come from. Null means the same products as the target.

maxApplications.description: How many sets per cart at most. Null means unlimited.

RewardBuyXGetYReward.description:
"Buy X get Y": "3 for 2" is `buyQuantity: 2, getQuantity: 1`; "second item 50% off" is
`buyQuantity: 1, getQuantity: 1, discountPercent: 50`.

RewardFixedUnitPriceReward.description: "Selected products for 99.90 each". Units already used by other unit offers are skipped.

maxAmount.description: Optional cap; null means the whole shipping fee.

RewardGiftProductReward.description: A free product added to the order (the channel adds the line; the engine reports it).

maxDiscount.description: Optional cap for this reward, e.g. "20% off, at most 200".

RewardTieredDiscountReward.description:
"Spend 500 get 50 off, spend 1000 get 150 off" or "buy 2 get 10%, buy 3 get 20%".
The highest reached tier applies. The basis is measured on the target lines at list price.

timeZone.description: IANA (`Europe/Istanbul`) or Windows time zone id.

daysOfWeek.description: If not empty, only on these days (local time).

dailyStart.description: Daily window start (local time, inclusive). A window may cross midnight, e.g. 22:00–02:00.

Schedule.description:
When a campaign is valid. Date boundaries are absolute instants; the weekly/daily window is
interpreted in string Schedule.TimeZone so that "every Saturday 10:00–14:00" means local store time.

SnapshotDocument.description:
The wire format of `GET /api/v1/snapshot`: every live campaign plus the product lists they
need. A channel can store it and evaluate carts locally (e.g. a POS while offline).

include.description: If not empty, only these stores.

ApiKey.description: API key of the calling system.
ApiKey.name: X-Api-Key

Session.description: Session token from POST /api/v1/auth/login (web app users).
